name: Crystal Quest: Deep Jungle
review:
Crystal Quest: Deep Jungle follows explorer Gemma on 6 reels with 4,096 ways. Infinite multipliers, avalanches and a mystery feature drive the action.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 15,000x cap and a 96.14% RTP.

The mystery feature reveals matching symbols across the grid, which works well with 4,096 ways. Pick this entry if you want the most straightforward version of the trilogy's cascade-and-multiplier loop.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
